messages:
maya: quick heads-up — planning a dry-run of the kernel-ABI shim + quantized matmul path in staging tonight 00:30 UTC. @deploy-bot will schedule the job. please ack if you need exclusion windows or extra smoke checks.
chris: ack. can you call out exact rollback criteria? :eyes:
samir: ping — which kernel and quant build are we exercising? i want to make sure model pins are compatible.
maya: good q. we’ll use kernel v3.4-shim1 + quant qv2.2. staging models pinned to model-bundle@2026-02-14 to avoid model drift.
maya: rollback criteria (short):
  - host-level error rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m
  - p95 latency +50ms over baseline for 5m
  - any model correctness smoke failing (top-k diffs > 1% on regression suite)
  - any OOMs on GPU drivers
chris: sounds reasonable. add automatic pin fallback to previous kernel if we detect driver OOM.
maya: yep — deploy config includes fallback: kernel -> v3.3-stable if shim fails. deploy-bot will attempt auto-pin then alert.
priya: please add release-notes checklist items: smoke results, perf diff table, QA signoff, and the one-line migration note for infra. i’ll draft the blurb.
jen: +1. also add a short note for SRE on how to force-evict the KV cache if we see prefix cache blowups. i’ll paste snippet in comments.
jen: snippet:
```
# force eviction on node
curl -X POST https://staging-internal/api/v1/evict -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"node":"node-12"}'
```
deploy-bot: scheduled job id=7890 for 2026-03-01T00:30:00Z (dry-run, traffic=0%). Notifying channels: eng-runtime, eng-sre.
opsbot: smoke-run complete (dry-run, no traffic). Results: 23/24 smoke checks passed. One host node-12 reported transient OOM on matmul shard 4 at 00:31:12.
priya: node-12 again? can we isolate if it’s infra vs build?
samir: that host has slightly older driver (525.7). shim expected to be tolerant but not guaranteed. recommend excluding node-12 from next staging run.
chris: exclude it, re-run dry-run with identical config. if OOM reproduces on different host, escalate.
maya: plan: exclude node-12, schedule re-run at 00:45 UTC with same job id 7890.replay. will attach perf diffs and top-k regressions.
deploy-bot: job id=7890.replay started. traffic=0%. excluded nodes=[node-12].
opsbot: replay smoke done — all checks green, no OOMs. p95 latency delta = +12ms (within threshold). top-k diffs = 0.4%.
jen: looks safe for canary traffic slice. suggest canary at 1% traffic for 30m then 5% for 30m with close monitoring.
priya: i’ll update release notes draft and add the QA summary + link to perf spreadsheet: https://internal.sheets/runtime-qv2.2-shim1
chris: agreed. do canary in staging->preprod first, then prod rollout during the 02:00-05:00 UTC change window if metrics stay healthy.
maya: final checklist before traffic canary:
  - prod canary runbook pushed to PagerDuty ops channel
  - alert thresholds set (error rate, latency pctile, model-regression)
  - rollback pin ready (v3.3-stable)
  - postmortem template created in case of regression

maya: thanks all. i’ll flip the ticket to "ready for canary" and post release-note link. :thumbsup:
